Remark
[Soliton origin of the extension equations] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0299, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0300 1. ch15:15.17\group Harnack Evolution Equations

The spatial extension equation for $U$ is obtained by taking $U=W\wedge abla f$ on a normalized expanding gradient soliton and using $ abla ^2f=-\Ric -g/(2t)$. The time equations are the corresponding parabolic extensions at the chosen point.
